arguments.command:
python3 -c "
from more_itertools import seekable
from itertools import count

it = seekable((str(n) for n in count()))
print(f'next(it): {next(it)}')  # '0'
print(f'next(it): {next(it)}')  # '1'
print(f'next(it): {next(it)}')  # '2'
print(f'cache: {it._cache}, _index: {it._index}')
it.relative_seek(1)
print(f'After relative_seek(1), cache: {it._cache}, _index: {it._index}')
val = next(it)
print(f'After relative_seek(1), next: {val}')
print(f'cache: {it._cache}, _index: {it._index}')
it.relative_seek(-2)
print(f'After relative_seek(-2), cache: {it._cache}, _index: {it._index}')
val = next(it)
print(f'After relative_seek(-2), next: {val}')
" 2>&1
